findings.defect: Expired SOL/USD was reused indefinitely as last-good after provider failure
findings.risk: Current entry, exit, cost and research USD valuations could consume an unbounded old exchange rate
findings.remediation: Retain immutable original client/provider clocks, bounded dual age checks and monotonic cache expiry; failed refresh clears old proof and returns unknown

findings.defect: Missing historical entry notional was reconstructed from today's SOL/USD
findings.risk: Rewrites historical money basis and can fabricate comparable financial returns
findings.remediation: No current FX backfill; recompute metrics only for already-known original notionals and reject unvalued paper fills

findings.defect: Live canary substituted SOL/USD=1 on unavailable conversion and treated missing outcomes as zero
findings.risk: Wrong SOL-denominated budget or lost loss-streak state
findings.remediation: Explicit unknown canary close; preserve loss history and block further admissions in that process state instead of inventing currency or return

Live canary unknown valuation does not reset known losses or invent SOL/USD=1; no live activation

Publishing secret scanner does not consume the next line after an empty credential assignment; real secret values remain blocked
New optional settings are documented as comments in the template without rewriting the private environment or changing its required key set
